name: Captcha questions
description: Require users to answer a configurable question
project_description: Captcha questions is a light-weight module that employs a very simple captcha mechanism to stop unwanted form submissions, be they comment spam or account registrations. It has no dependencies and is not affiliated with the CAPTCHA module. The administrator defines one question and one or more accepted answers, then chooses which forms (by form_id) should be protected. When an anonymous user submits a protected form, a required text field asks the question; if the lowercased answer is not among the accepted answers the form fails validation with an 'Invalid answer' error. Answers are case-insensitive. The recommended pattern is a question so easy that a human can answer it instantly (often with the answer embedded in the question, e.g. 'What is Mickeys last name? Its Mouse.'), while automated scripts cannot. The challenge is shown to anonymous users only. Optional logging of failed submissions is available to the Drupal log (watchdog) and, via the captcha_questions_dblog submodule, to a dedicated database table with an admin report.
